result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visual defects: a loading spinner stuck on top of an already-rendered image, truncated text on a horizontally scrolled card, and a partially clipped category chip. Overall 3 issues found (1 major, 2 minor).

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image even though the image content appears fully rendered behind it, suggesting the loading state was never dismissed.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the spinner is removed once the image finishes loading (hook into the image load/error events), and add a timeout/fallback so the spinner never persists over loaded content.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the screen edge with no ellipsis, making the full name unreadable in the visible viewport.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis within the card width, or add right padding/peek spacing so partially visible cards clearly indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: An empty, unlabeled category chip is clipped at the right edge after 'Healthy', appearing as a blank gray sliver with no visible text.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek amount so the next chip shows at least part of its label, or add a fade gradient at the edge to indicate more items exist.
